title: Expo SDK 58 Beta is now available
description: The SDK 58 beta period begins today and will last three to four weeks. The beta is an opportunity for developers to test out the SDK and ensure that the new release does not introduce any regressions for their particular systems and app configurations. We will be continuously releasing fixes and improvements during the beta period. SDK 58 is built for iOS 27, and you can ship with the beta if you want iOS 27 support in your app now. SDK 58 beta includes React Native 0.88 (Release Candidate). React Native 0.88 has not been released yet, so the beta uses the release candidate. We will move to the stable release when React Native 0.88 ships, and release SDK 58 shortly after. summary_ja: Expo SDK 58ベータが3～4週間の期間で利用可能になり、iOS 27対応やReact Native 0.88 RC（リリース候補版）が含まれています。開発者はベータ期間中にテストを行い、回帰問題がないか確認できます。React Native 0.88の正式版リリース後、SDK 58の安定版がリリースされる予定です。

title: Flet 1.0
description: Today, we're releasing Flet 1.0 ! 🎉 More than four years ago, we introduced Flet with a simple idea: building a cross-platform app should be within reach of anyone who knows Python. Since then, that idea has grown through the apps you've built , the feedback you've shared, and the contributions you've made. Today, Flet has more than 16,700 stars on GitHub , 100 contributors and has been downloaded from PyPI more than 9,000,000 times ! We've merged over 1,000 pull requests , closed 2,800 issues and our Discord community has grown to more than 6,000 members. Getting started is easier, too: Flet Studio lets you build, explore, and share apps in your browser with help from its AI agent. summary_ja: Flet 1.0がリリースされ、Pythonでのクロスプラットフォームアプリ開発がさらに容易になりました。ブラウザ上でアプリを構築・共有できるFlet Studioと、AIコーディングアシスタント向けのFlet MCPサーバーが新たに提供されます。GitHubで16,700以上のスター、900万回以上のPyPI ダウンロード、6,000人以上のDiscordコミュニティを達成し、プロダクション対応レベルの成熟度に到達しています。
